prompt_template.system: You extract exact biomedical synonym pairs from text. Reply with pipe lines only — no introduction.
prompt_template.human:
From the abstract below, output synonym pairs as lines:
original|is|synonym

Rules:
- Use terms exactly as they appear in the text.
- Parenthetical names count (e.g. Aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid) → Aspirin|is|acetylsalicylic acid).
- One pair per line; no header; no other text.
- If no synonym pairs exist, output a single line: NONE

Abstract:
{text}
